title: Classic Valencian Paella
description: A traditional Spanish dish originating from the Valencia region, made with saffron-infused rice, succulent seafood, and savory chicken.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and onion and sauté until softened.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink.
Add the tomato and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the Valencian rice and stir to coat with oil.
Add the quinoa (if using), aerated chicken broth, and paella.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Stir in the saffron and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
